name: ordinary-oracle-convergence-v1
question: Do ordinary all-legal MultiPV root and opponent-reply labels stabilize as Stockfish computation increases, and is fixed-total or per-legal-reply budgeting more efficient?
status: frozen before new Experiment 017 oracle probing
source: The 24 root and 134 opponent-parent SHA-selected development contexts frozen before Experiment 016
oracle: Stockfish 18, one thread, 16 MB hash, all-legal MultiPV, new-game boundary per context
prospective_gate: For both root and parent contexts: top move >=85%, top-3 Jaccard >=80%, within-25-cp Jaccard >=75%, 25/50/100-cp label agreement >=90%, and median regret difference <=25 cp
cross_rule_gate: The deepest fixed-total and per-reply endpoints must pass the same gate before any tier is eligible
selection: Choose the eligible tier with the lowest mean requested nodes after it passes against its next level and family maximum
development_guardrail: A passing tier is only a finite-budget development training target, not perfect chess truth
